fence.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FIRST-PASS production concept sheet for a small crafted fence in a warm low-poly farming/building game. This concept must precede model construction.
Primary request: one simple ALL-WOOD two-rail fence segment assembled from sawn timber. Two stout square posts, two narrow horizontal rails, four small visible WOODEN dowel heads. Flat chamfered top edges on posts, no separate decorative post caps. Rails are inset into the inward sides of posts, not giant flat boards. Keep wide open gaps.
Style: warm handcrafted low-poly, chunky readable planar geometry, restrained honey ochre timber #B77E43, lighter cut ends, subtle straight lengthwise wood grain and one or two wood knots; no metal. Orthographic construction clarity, realistic consistent structure across views.
Composition: ivory background, spacious horizontal landscape design sheet. Large front-three-quarter hero at upper left, clean front orthographic at upper right, exact side orthographic lower right, small exploded timber assembly lower left. All panels show the SAME design. Callouts use only these simple labels: "FENCE", "3/4", "FRONT", "SIDE", "PARTS", "0.96", "0.80", "0.16". Minimal dimension arrows.
Proportions in game units: total width 0.96, height 0.80, depth 0.16. Posts centered 0.40 left/right, 0.14 square, from ground to 0.80. Rails centered at height 0.27 and 0.56, each 0.12 tall and 0.085 deep; visible rail span 0.66. Show construction clearly, squared wood with subtle bevels, no bowed bars, no gate or hinges.
Lighting: soft neutral studio illustration, no dramatic black shadows. Material reference only, not a scene or in-game screenshot.
Avoid: people, animals, flowers, grass, ground tiles, plants, rocks, rope, metal, nails, bolts, lettering beyond requested labels, ornate ornament, extra rails, extra posts, buildings, gameplay UI. Do not depict any bench.

bench.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FIRST-PASS production concept sheet for a small crafted wooden bench in a warm low-poly farming/building game. This concept must precede model construction.
Primary request: one simple ALL-WOOD outdoor bench made from recognizable sawn timber components. Three separate horizontal seat slats running left-right with clear narrow gaps, two separate horizontal backrest slats with a clear gap, two thick full-height rear legs continuing into upright back supports, two shorter front legs, two front-to-back seat-support beams and one low left-right stretcher connecting the sides.
